name: mixed or low-signal feature
description: Tokens and example comments share no coherent theme, spanning brand names, prison-drama references, hardware, and unrelated anecdotes.

name: going back far enough in time or family
description: Activates on reflective passages about tracing things back far in time, shared ancestry, or stepping back from family over long spans.

name: embedded Tumblr image links
description: Fires on comments containing Tumblr media image URLs (media.tumblr.com .jpg links) attached to short captions.

name: mixed or low-signal feature
description: Tokens and examples have no shared theme, mixing weekly grocery spending, a band fact, a religion link, and a soccer match report.

name: support systems, exes and relationships
description: Activates on first-person narration about leaning on a support system, handling past relationships and exes, with occasional gear references.

name: the word "compound": lifts, butters, sentences
description: Fires on uses of "compound" across contexts: compound lifts, compound butters, and compound nouns or sentences.

name: long reflective essays on personal experience
description: Activates on long, discursive first-person passages reflecting on reading aloud, the elderly, weaning, religion, and decades of memory.

name: comments linking to blogs and articles
description: Fires on comments that embed external blog or article hyperlinks, frequently WordPress, tor.com, and news domains.

name: recommending a reference handbook or guide
description: Activates on text suggesting a published handbook or guide as a resource, such as a graphic artist's pricing and ethics guidelines.

name: ambivalence about having children
description: Fires on discussion of parenting and the number of kids, framed around feeling ambivalent or unenthusiastic about being a parent.
